verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud platform, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations such as launch configurations or provisioning workflows is a fair axis. The evidence only shows adjacent primitives: the REST API, launch-time cloud-init, Slurm scheduling, and filesystems that can back up system state. Nothing documents versioning, review, or rollback of automations themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
